q: 你见过他几___？
zh: 你见过他几次？
py: nǐ jiàn guo tā jǐ cì
en: How many times have you met him?
why: Meetings are counted as occasions: 几次, after the pronoun 他. 遍 means a whole run-through and does not suit meeting someone.

q: 小王不在，他去___北京出差，周五才回来。
zh: 小王不在，他去了北京出差，周五才回来。
py: xiǎo wáng bù zài tā qù le běi jīng chū chāi zhōu wǔ cái huí lái
en: Xiao Wang isn't here; he has gone to Beijing on a business trip and won't be back until Friday.
why: 不在 and 周五才回来 show the trip is still going on, so a completed event whose result holds: 了. 过 would say he has been and returned.

s: 小王刚才来过，说下午再来找你。
s_py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái lái guo shuō xià wǔ zài lái zhǎo nǐ
zh: 小王刚才来过，说下午再来找你。
py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái lái guo shuō xià wǔ zài lái zhǎo nǐ
en: Xiao Wang came by just now and said he would come back for you this afternoon.
why: 过 is fine with 刚才: it says he came and has left again, which fits 'will come again this afternoon'.

s: 我问过两次他。
s_py: wǒ wèn guo liǎng cì tā
zh: 我问过他两次。
py: wǒ wèn guo tā liǎng cì
en: I have asked him twice.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 问过他两次. Only ordinary nouns and place names can follow the count.

src_py: wǒ méi dǎ guo gāo ěr fū qiú
task: Ask 'you' with a 没有 question.
zh: 你打过高尔夫球没有？
py: nǐ dǎ guo gāo ěr fū qiú méi yǒu
en: Have you ever played golf?
why: The question keeps 过 and ends with 没有. The A-not-A form with 不 is never used.

s: 我们打篮球过。
s_py: wǒ men dǎ lán qiú guo
zh: 我们打过篮球。
py: wǒ men dǎ guo lán qiú
en: We have played basketball.
why: 过 must sit right after the verb 打, before the object. At the end of the sentence it is left hanging.

q: 他爱踢球，但是还___参加过正式的比赛，所以有点紧张。
zh: 他爱踢球，但是还没参加过正式的比赛，所以有点紧张。
py: tā ài tī qiú dàn shì hái méi cān jiā guo zhèng shì de bǐ sài suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng
en: He loves playing football but has never taken part in an official match, so he is a bit nervous.
why: 没参加过 negates experience and 过 stays. 还不参加过 is impossible, because 不 and 过 never combine.

s: 我们昨天打了一场篮球，今天腿很酸。
s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān dǎ le yī chǎng lán qiú jīn tiān tuǐ hěn suān
zh: 我们昨天打了一场篮球，今天腿很酸。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān dǎ le yī chǎng lán qiú jīn tiān tuǐ hěn suān
en: We played a game of basketball yesterday, and my legs are sore today.
why: One specific game yesterday with a lasting result is told with 了. 过 would only say we have played basketball at some time.

s: 他们以前见面过。
s_py: tā men yǐ qián jiàn miàn guo
zh: 他们以前见过面。
py: tā men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: They have met before.
why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 见过面. 见面过 is not possible.

q: 他曾经在国家队踢___球，现在已经当教练了。
zh: 他曾经在国家队踢过球，现在已经当教练了。
py: tā céng jīng zài guó jiā duì tī guo qiú xiàn zài yǐ jīng dāng jiào liàn le
en: He once played football for the national team and is a coach now.
why: 曾经 marks a finished stretch of the past, so 过 follows the verb 踢 inside 踢球. 了 clashes with 曾经, and 着 would mean he is still playing.

q: 他去___上海，下个星期才回来。
zh: 他去了上海，下个星期才回来。
py: tā qù le shàng hǎi xià ge xīng qī cái huí lái
en: He has gone to Shanghai and won't be back until next week.
why: 下个星期才回来 means he is still away, so the trip is a completed event with a lasting result: 了. 过 would mean he went and is already back.

q: 这家店我以前来___，东西不便宜。
zh: 这家店我以前来过，东西不便宜。
py: zhè jiā diàn wǒ yǐ qián lái guo dōng xi bù pián yi
en: I have been to this shop before, and the things there aren't cheap.
why: 以前 plus knowing the prices points to experience: 来过. 来了 would only report that I arrived, so it cannot carry 'I have been here before'.

zh: 我从来没玩过这种游戏。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi wán guo zhè zhǒng yóu xì
en: I have never played this kind of game.
why: The chain is 从来 + 没 + verb + 过, in that order. 从来 must come before 没, and the object may be fronted as a topic.

task: Turn it into a 有没有 question.
zh: 你有没有打过网球？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu dǎ guo wǎng qiú
en: Have you ever played tennis?
why: 有没有 goes before 打过, and no 吗 follows. The object may be fronted as a topic.

q: 你以前看___这个电影吗？
zh: 你以前看过这个电影吗？
py: nǐ yǐ qián kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng ma
en: Have you ever seen this film?
why: 以前 and 'ever' ask about experience, so 过. 了 would ask whether you watched it on one particular occasion.

q: 你去___去过那家新开的运动用品店？听说里面的东西很全。
zh: 你去没去过那家新开的运动用品店？听说里面的东西很全。
py: nǐ qù méi qù guo nà jiā xīn kāi de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn tīng shuō lǐ miàn de dōng xi hěn quán
en: Have you been to that newly opened sports shop? I hear they have everything.
why: The A-not-A form of 去过 is 去没去过, built on 没. 去不去过 is wrong because 不 never goes with 过.

q: 我昨天买___一双球鞋，今天就穿上了。
zh: 我昨天买了一双球鞋，今天就穿上了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié jīn tiān jiù chuān shang le
en: I bought a pair of sneakers yesterday and put them on today.
why: One specific purchase told as part of a story (买, then 穿上) takes 了. 过 would only say I have bought sneakers at some time, not this pair.

q: 他说已经问___老板了，老板同意给我们打九折。
zh: 他说已经问过老板了，老板同意给我们打九折。
py: tā shuō yǐ jīng wèn guo lǎo bǎn le lǎo bǎn tóng yì gěi wǒ men dǎ jiǔ zhé
en: He says he has already asked the boss, and the boss agreed to give us 10% off.
why: 问过老板了 = the asking is already done. 着 would mean he is asking at this moment, which does not fit 已经…同意.

task: Say you have never been, not even once (use 从来).
zh: 我从来没去过北京。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo běi jīng
en: I have never been to Beijing.
why: 从来 comes before 没 and 过 stays on the verb: 从来没去过. 从来不去过 is impossible.

src: 我从来没买过贵的球鞋。
src_py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo guì de qiú xié
task: Change it to a habit: you never buy them.
zh: 我从来不买贵的球鞋。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù mǎi guì de qiú xié
en: I never buy expensive sneakers.
why: A habit takes 从来不 and no 过; 从来没…过 is about your whole past up to now. Putting 过 after 不 is wrong.

q: 你有没有___过这种球鞋？
zh: 你有没有穿过这种球鞋？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu chuān guo zhè zhǒng qiú xié
en: Have you ever worn this type of sneaker?
why: 有没有 comes before the bare verb and 过 follows it: 有没有穿过. 了 and 着 are not added, and 不穿 would be a different question.

q: 我妈妈年轻时跳___舞，还拿过奖。
zh: 我妈妈年轻时跳过舞，还拿过奖。
py: wǒ mā ma nián qīng shí tiào guo wǔ hái ná guo jiǎng
en: My mother used to dance when she was young and even won a prize.
why: 年轻时 puts it firmly in the past as part of her experience, so 过 goes inside 跳舞. 着 would mean she is dancing right now, and 了 cannot split 跳舞 like this.

q: 我从来___喝咖啡，因为喝了晚上就睡不着。
zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，因为喝了晚上就睡不着。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi yīn wèi hē le wǎn shang jiù shuì bu zháo
en: I never drink coffee, because if I do I can't sleep at night.
why: A habit with no 过 takes 从来不: 'I never drink it'. 从来没 would need 过 to say 'never once', and 别 is only for commands.

q: 这部电视剧我从头到尾看过两___，连台词都记住了。
zh: 这部电视剧我从头到尾看过两遍，连台词都记住了。
py: zhè bù diàn shì jù wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi kàn guo liǎng biàn lián tái cí dōu jì zhù le
en: I've watched this TV series from beginning to end twice, and I even remember the lines.
why: 从头到尾 means a full run-through, which takes 遍. 个, 位 and 件 are not counters for repeating an action.

q: 我___去过上海，很想去看看。
zh: 我没去过上海，很想去看看。
py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi hěn xiǎng qù kàn kan
en: I have never been to Shanghai and would love to see it.
why: 过 is negated with 没, never 不: 没去过 = have never been. 不去过 does not exist, and 别 is for commands.

q: “你滑过雪吗？”“___，我很想试试。”
zh: “你滑过雪吗？”“没滑过，我很想试试。”
py: nǐ huá guo xuě ma méi huá guo wǒ hěn xiǎng shì shi
en: "Have you ever skied?" "No, I haven't, but I'd love to try."
why: The answer repeats the verb with 没 and 过: 没滑过. 不滑 means 'I don't ski', which clashes with 'I'd love to try'.

q: 我在海边游___泳___，水很清。
zh: 我在海边游过泳，水很清。
py: wǒ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng shuǐ hěn qīng
en: I have swum at the seaside; the water was clear.
why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 goes after 游. 游泳过 is wrong because 过 must follow the verb part directly.

q: 我去过三___北京，每次都住在朋友家。
zh: 我去过三次北京，每次都住在朋友家。
py: wǒ qù guo sān cì běi jīng měi cì dōu zhù zài péng you jiā
en: I've been to Beijing three times, and each time I stayed with a friend.
why: Going somewhere is counted in occasions: 三次. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, and 个 and 下 are not the counters for trips.

q: 我还没去___那家新开的健身房，不知道好不好。
zh: 我还没去过那家新开的健身房，不知道好不好。
py: wǒ hái méi qù guo nà jiā xīn kāi de jiàn shēn fáng bù zhī dào hǎo bu hǎo
en: I haven't been to that newly opened gym yet, so I don't know if it's any good.
why: 还没…过 means 'have not yet been'. 过 stays after the verb, and 了 cannot appear after 没.

s: 这个游戏我玩过两遍，没有那么难。
s_py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ wán guo liǎng biàn méi yǒu nà me nán
zh: 这个游戏我玩过两遍，没有那么难。
py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ wán guo liǎng biàn méi yǒu nà me nán
en: I've played through this game twice, and it isn't that hard.
why: With the object fronted, the count follows 过: 玩过两遍. 遍 is right for playing a game through from start to finish.

zh: 你吃过饭了吗？
py: nǐ chī guo fàn le ma
en: Have you eaten yet?
why: V过了 asks whether a routine thing is already done, with the object between 过 and 了. The answer repeats the pattern or is 还没呢.

zh: 这个动作我练过很多遍。
py: zhè ge dòng zuò wǒ liàn guo hěn duō biàn
en: I have practised this move many times.
why: With the object fronted, the count follows 过 directly: 练过很多遍. 遍 fits repeating a whole move from start to finish.

q: 这个月的会员费我交___了，你不用再交了。
zh: 这个月的会员费我交过了，你不用再交了。
py: zhè ge yuè de huì yuán fèi wǒ jiāo guo le nǐ bù yòng zài jiāo le
en: I've already paid this month's membership fee, so you don't need to pay again.
why: 交过了 reports that the routine payment is already done. 着 would mean I am paying right now, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

zh: 这首歌我听过很多遍。
py: zhè shǒu gē wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn
en: I've listened to this song many times.
why: With a fronted topic the count follows 过 directly: 听过很多遍. A song heard from start to finish is counted with 遍.

s: 我没买过了那双球鞋。
s_py: wǒ méi mǎi guo le nà shuāng qiú xié
zh: 我没买过那双球鞋。
py: wǒ méi mǎi guo nà shuāng qiú xié
en: I have never bought that pair of sneakers.
why: 了 cannot follow 没 or 没…过. Experience is negated with 没…过 alone.

s: 你有没有试过这种运动鞋？
s_py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shì guo zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié
zh: 你有没有试过这种运动鞋？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shì guo zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié
en: Have you ever tried this kind of sports shoe?
why: 有没有 + verb + 过 is a complete experience question. No 吗 and no 了 are added.

zh: 药我已经吃过了。
py: yào wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le
en: I've already taken the medicine.
why: 已经 sits before the verb 吃过 and 了 closes the sentence. The object either goes between 过 and 了 or is fronted as the topic.

s: 他的球拍丢过，现在正在到处找。
s_py: tā de qiú pāi diū guo xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
zh: 他的球拍丢了，现在正在到处找。
py: tā de qiú pāi diū le xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
en: His racket is lost, and he is looking for it everywhere right now.
why: He is looking for it now, so the loss is a fresh event with a lasting result: 了. 丢过 says it was lost at some time before.

zh: 我没去过那家店。
py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā diàn
en: I have never been to that shop.
why: 没 goes before the verb and 过 stays on it: 没去过. 不 and 了 are not used, and the object may be fronted as the topic.

q: 他曾经学___吉他，可是一首歌也没学会。
zh: 他曾经学过吉他，可是一首歌也没学会。
py: tā céng jīng xué guo jí tā kě shì yī shǒu gē yě méi xué huì
en: He once took guitar lessons, but he never learned a single song.
why: 曾经 and the outcome 没学会 mark learning the guitar as a past experience: 学过. 了 does not combine with 曾经, and 着 would mean he is still studying.

q: 这么多年了，我还___去过那个小岛，一直想去看看。
zh: 这么多年了，我还没去过那个小岛，一直想去看看。
py: zhè me duō nián le wǒ hái méi qù guo nà ge xiǎo dǎo yī zhí xiǎng qù kàn kan
en: After all these years I still haven't been to that little island, and I've always wanted to go.
why: 还没去过 = still not been. 不 cannot be used with 过, and 别 is only for orders.

s: 他去过北京，下个月才回来。
s_py: tā qù guo běi jīng xià ge yuè cái huí lái
zh: 他去了北京，下个月才回来。
py: tā qù le běi jīng xià ge yuè cái huí lái
en: He has gone to Beijing and won't be back until next month.
why: 下个月才回来 means he is still away, so 了 is needed. 过 would mean he has already been and returned.

q: 我在这家店见过___两次___。
zh: 我在这家店见过他两次。
py: wǒ zài zhè jiā diàn jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
en: I have seen him in this shop twice.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 见过他两次. 见过两次他 is a classic mistake, since only ordinary nouns and place names can follow the count.

zh: 我去过两次上海。
py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì shàng hǎi
en: I have been to Shanghai twice.
why: 过 comes straight after 去 and the count goes before the place name here: 去过两次上海. The count cannot come before the verb.

q: 这条路我以前走___，前面有个很大的坡，骑车要小心。
zh: 这条路我以前走过，前面有个很大的坡，骑车要小心。
py: zhè tiáo lù wǒ yǐ qián zǒu guo qián miàn yǒu gè hěn dà de pō qí chē yào xiǎo xīn
en: I've walked this road before; there's a big slope ahead, so be careful if you cycle.
why: 以前 and the warning about the slope show the speaker knows the road from earlier experience: 过. 着 would mean they are walking it now.

q: 他在这个游泳馆教___孩子们游泳___，现在换了地方。
zh: 他在这个游泳馆教过孩子们游泳，现在换了地方。
py: tā zài zhè ge yóu yǒng guǎn jiāo guo hái zi men yóu yǒng xiàn zài huàn le dì fang
en: He once taught children to swim at this swimming pool; now he has moved somewhere else.
why: 过 belongs to 教, the main verb, so it comes right after it, before 孩子们游泳. At the very end (游泳过) it would attach to nothing.

zh: 你去过那家商店没有？
py: nǐ qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn méi yǒu
en: Have you ever been to that shop?
why: The experience question ends with 没有, and 过 stays on 去. 不 cannot be used here.

q: 我以前在这个球场工作___，对这里很熟。
zh: 我以前在这个球场工作过，对这里很熟。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng gōng zuò guo duì zhè lǐ hěn shú
en: I used to work at this sports ground, so I know it well.
why: 以前 and 对这里很熟 present the job as past experience: 工作过. 着 would mean I am working there now, and a bare 了 would leave 工作 unfinished without a length of time.

zh: 我们以前见过面。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes between 见 and 面. 见面过 is wrong, and 以前 can sit before or after the subject.

s: 我从来不买过这么贵的东西。
s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi
zh: 我从来没买过这么贵的东西。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi
en: I have never bought anything this expensive.
why: With 过 the negative must be 没. 从来不 exists only for habits and takes no 过.

q: 你去过那个球场___？
zh: 你去过那个球场吗？
py: nǐ qù guo nà ge qiú chǎng ma
en: Have you been to that sports ground?
why: A yes/no experience question ends with 吗. 不 cannot be used with 过, and 的 and 呢 do not form this question.

zh: 他从来没在这个球场打过球。
py: tā cóng lái méi zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo qiú
en: He has never played ball at this ground.
why: 从来没 comes before the place phrase and 过 stays on 打. The place phrase can also move in front of 从来 or the subject, but 过 never leaves the verb.

zh: 我找过她三次。
py: wǒ zhǎo guo tā sān cì
en: I have gone looking for her three times.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 找过她三次. 找过三次她 is the classic error.

q: 昨天晚上我们先吃饭，然后看___一场比赛。
zh: 昨天晚上我们先吃饭，然后看了一场比赛。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men xiān chī fàn rán hòu kàn le yī chǎng bǐ sài
en: Last night we had dinner first and then watched a match.
why: 先…然后 is a chain of events told in order, which takes 了. 过 would turn the match into a life experience, which does not fit the story.

s: 我没有看过这个节目。
s_py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè ge jié mù
zh: 我没有看过这个节目。
py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè ge jié mù
en: I haven't seen this programme.
why: 没有 + verb + 过 is correct: the negative of 过 is 没 or 没有, and 过 stays.

q: 我已经吃___饭了，你们不用等我。
zh: 我已经吃过饭了，你们不用等我。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo fàn le nǐ men bù yòng děng wǒ
en: I've already eaten, so you don't need to wait for me.
why: 吃过饭了 says the meal is already done, with the object between 过 and 了. 着 would mean I am eating right now.

q: 我来过这个商场___，但是没买过东西。
zh: 我来过这个商场几次，但是没买过东西。
py: wǒ lái guo zhè ge shāng chǎng jǐ cì dàn shì méi mǎi guo dōng xi
en: I've been to this mall a few times, but I have never bought anything.
why: Visits are counted with 次: 几次. 遍 is for whole run-throughs of a book, film or song, and 个 and 下 do not count visits.

zh: 我还没去过长城。
py: wǒ hái méi qù guo cháng chéng
en: I haven't been to the Great Wall yet.
why: 还 comes before 没 and 过 stays on the verb: 还没去过. 还 cannot go after 没.

task: Make it negative: he has never had them.
zh: 他没有吃过饺子。
py: tā méi yǒu chī guo jiǎo zi
en: He has never eaten dumplings.
why: 没有 goes before the verb and 过 stays: 没有吃过. Dropping 过 would give 'he did not eat them', a single occasion.

s: 我不去过那家商店。
s_py: wǒ bù qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn
zh: 我没去过那家商店。
py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn
en: I have never been to that shop.
why: 过 is negated with 没, not 不. 不去过 does not exist.

q: 你去商店看___那件外套了吗？价钱怎么样？
zh: 你去商店看过那件外套了吗？价钱怎么样？
py: nǐ qù shāng diàn kàn guo nà jiàn wài tào le ma jià qian zěn me yàng
en: Did you go to the shop and have a look at that coat? How much was it?
why: 看过…了吗 asks 'have you already done it?' about an expected errand. 着 would ask whether you are looking at it now.

q: 我从来没见___这么大的体育馆，里面能坐好几万人。
zh: 我从来没见过这么大的体育馆，里面能坐好几万人。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me dà de tǐ yù guǎn lǐ miàn néng zuò hǎo jǐ wàn rén
en: I have never seen such a big stadium; tens of thousands of people could sit in it.
why: 从来没见过这么…的… 'never seen such a …' keeps 过. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 is not an experience marker.

q: 这个故事我听过很多___，已经会讲了。
zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍，已经会讲了。
py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn yǐ jīng huì jiǎng le
en: I have heard this story many times and can tell it myself by now.
why: 听 a story all the way through is counted with 遍. 个, 下 and 位 are not counters for hearing something again and again.

q: “你吃药了吗？”“还没___呢。”
zh: “你吃药了吗？”“还没吃呢。”
py: nǐ chī yào le ma hái méi chī ne
en: "Have you taken your medicine?" "Not yet."
why: The negative of 'already done' is 还没 + verb (+ 呢). 了 cannot follow 没, and 吃过了 is the positive 'already eaten'.

task: Say you have already eaten lunch (use 过).
zh: 我吃过午饭了。
py: wǒ chī guo wǔ fàn le
en: I've already had lunch.
why: V过了 says a routine thing is already done: 过 right after the verb and 了 at the end, with the object between them or fronted.

q: 她还没有买___这么贵的东西，所以有点不敢。
zh: 她还没有买过这么贵的东西，所以有点不敢。
py: tā hái méi yǒu mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn bù gǎn
en: She has never bought anything this expensive, so she is a bit nervous about it.
why: 'Never bought such a thing' is 没有买过 with 过 kept. 了 cannot follow 没有, and 着 would not give a meaning of experience.

s: 他去年在这个球场打过一次比赛。
s_py: tā qù nián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo yī cì bǐ sài
zh: 他去年在这个球场打过一次比赛。
py: tā qù nián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo yī cì bǐ sài
en: Last year he played a match once at this ground.
why: 过 plus a count is fine even with a past time word like 去年: it says there was one such occasion, and the object follows the count.

q: 她在这个球场参加过两___比赛，今年想再来一次。
zh: 她在这个球场参加过两次比赛，今年想再来一次。
py: tā zài zhè ge qiú chǎng cān jiā guo liǎng cì bǐ sài jīn nián xiǎng zài lái yī cì
en: She has taken part in competitions at this ground twice, and wants to come again this year.
why: Taking part in competitions is counted in occasions: 两次. 遍 would mean going through one event from start to end, which does not fit 参加.

q: 我___有看过这场比赛，不知道谁赢了。
zh: 我没有看过这场比赛，不知道谁赢了。
py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè chǎng bǐ sài bù zhī dào shéi yíng le
en: I haven't seen this match, so I don't know who won.
why: 没有 + 过 is the negative of experience: 没有看过. 不有 does not exist, and 别 is a command.

q: 这种牌子的运动鞋我以前穿___，很舒服，这次还想买。
zh: 这种牌子的运动鞋我以前穿过，很舒服，这次还想买。
py: zhè zhǒng pái zi de yùn dòng xié wǒ yǐ qián chuān guo hěn shū fu zhè cì hái xiǎng mǎi
en: I've worn this brand of sports shoes before. They were comfortable, and I want to buy them again.
why: 穿过 says I have the experience of wearing them, which is why I want them again. 着 would mean I am wearing them now, and 得 and 地 are other particles that cannot follow a verb here.

s: 我还没吃过了，你们先吃吧。
s_py: wǒ hái méi chī guo le nǐ men xiān chī ba
zh: 我还没吃呢，你们先吃吧。
py: wǒ hái méi chī ne nǐ men xiān chī ba
en: I haven't eaten yet, so go ahead and eat.
why: 'Not yet' is 还没 + verb (+ 呢). 吃过了 means 'already eaten' and cannot follow 没.

s: 我吃过了，你们吃吧。
s_py: wǒ chī guo le nǐ men chī ba
zh: 我吃过了，你们吃吧。
py: wǒ chī guo le nǐ men chī ba
en: I've already eaten; you go ahead.
why: V过了 is a normal way to say a routine thing is already done, such as a meal. It is not about life experience.

s: 我从来不吃甜的东西，所以从来没买过蛋糕。
s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù chī tián de dōng xi suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi mǎi guo dàn gāo
zh: 我从来不吃甜的东西，所以从来没买过蛋糕。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù chī tián de dōng xi suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi mǎi guo dàn gāo
en: I never eat sweet things, so I have never bought a cake.
why: 从来不 states a habit and takes no 过, while 从来没…过 covers your whole past. Both are correct here.

task: Say he has gone to Shanghai (a recent event, not an experience).
zh: 他去了上海。
py: tā qù le shàng hǎi
en: He has gone to Shanghai.
why: Reporting a completed trip whose result still holds takes 了 right after the verb. 过 would only say he has been there at some time.

q: 我的钱包丢___，现在正在到处找。
zh: 我的钱包丢了，现在正在到处找。
py: wǒ de qián bāo diū le xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
en: I've lost my wallet and am looking for it everywhere right now.
why: The wallet is still missing, so the loss is a fresh event with a lasting result: 了. 丢过 would say it has been lost at some point before.

q: 我没打___网球，想先学学再打。
zh: 我没打过网球，想先学学再打。
py: wǒ méi dǎ guo wǎng qiú xiǎng xiān xué xue zài dǎ
en: I have never played tennis, so I want to learn first.
why: After 没 the experience marker 过 stays: 没打过 = have never played. 了 never follows 没, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

src_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng
task: Turn it into a 吗 question.
zh: 你看过这个电影吗？
py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng ma
en: Have you seen this film?
why: 吗 closes the question and 过 stays on the verb. Do not also add 不 or 没有 to the same question.

s: 你看过这本书没有吗？
s_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū méi yǒu ma
zh: 你看过这本书吗？
py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū ma
en: Have you read this book?
why: Use one question marker only: 吗 or 没有. Stacking 没有 and 吗 is not Chinese.

q: 我从来没试___在网上买衣服，不知道合不合适。
zh: 我从来没试过在网上买衣服，不知道合不合适。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi shì guo zài wǎng shàng mǎi yī fu bù zhī dào hé bu hé shì
en: I have never tried buying clothes online, so I don't know whether they would fit.
why: 从来没试过 = never once tried. 过 stays after 试, and 了 cannot appear after 没.

task: Make it negative: you have never been.
zh: 我没去过上海。
py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi
en: I have never been to Shanghai.
why: The negative of experience is 没 + verb + 过. 不 is not used with 过, and 了 never follows 没.

s: 你去不去过那家健身房？
s_py: nǐ qù bu qù guo nà jiā jiàn shēn fáng
zh: 你去没去过那家健身房？
py: nǐ qù méi qù guo nà jiā jiàn shēn fáng
en: Have you ever been to that gym?
why: The A-not-A form of 去过 is built on 没, because 过 is only ever negated with 没. 不 is wrong here.

q: 他先给我们看___他的新球拍，然后又带我们去了球场。
zh: 他先给我们看了他的新球拍，然后又带我们去了球场。
py: tā xiān gěi wǒ men kàn le tā de xīn qiú pāi rán hòu yòu dài wǒ men qù le qiú chǎng
en: He first showed us his new racket and then took us to the court.
why: 先…然后…又 narrates events in sequence, so each verb takes 了. 过 would make the showing a life experience, which makes no sense in a chain of events.

q: 我们在球场见___面___。
zh: 我们在球场见过面。
py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met at the court before.
why: 见面 is a verb plus object (见 + 面), so 过 goes between them: 见过面. Putting it at the end (见面过) is not possible.

q: 他是个很自律的人，从来___吃过夜宵，也从来不熬夜。
zh: 他是个很自律的人，从来没吃过夜宵，也从来不熬夜。
py: tā shì gè hěn zì lǜ de rén cóng lái méi chī guo yè xiāo yě cóng lái bù áo yè
en: He is a very disciplined person: he has never eaten a late-night snack and never stays up late.
why: With 过 the negative must be 没: 从来没吃过. 从来不吃过 is impossible, since 不 is for habits and takes no 过, as in the second half (从来不熬夜).

zh: 我买过这种球拍。
py: wǒ mǎi guo zhè zhǒng qiú pāi
en: I have bought this kind of racket before.
why: 过 sits straight after the verb 买: 买过. The object comes after it, or the whole object can be fronted as a topic.

q: 他结___婚___，有一个女儿。
zh: 他结过婚，有一个女儿。
py: tā jié guo hūn yǒu yī ge nǚ ér
en: He has been married and has a daughter.
why: 结婚 splits into 结 + 婚 and 过 goes after 结: 结过婚. 结婚过 puts 过 after the whole word, which Chinese does not allow.

q: 她曾经在大学里打___排球，现在只是偶尔打打。
zh: 她曾经在大学里打过排球，现在只是偶尔打打。
py: tā céng jīng zài dà xué lǐ dǎ guo pái qiú xiàn zài zhǐ shì ǒu ěr dǎ da
en: She once played volleyball at university; now she only plays occasionally.
why: 曾经 plus a contrast with now calls for experience 过. 着 would say she is playing at this moment, and 了 does not combine with 曾经.

q: 她买___那件外套，现在正穿着呢。
zh: 她买了那件外套，现在正穿着呢。
py: tā mǎi le nà jiàn wài tào xiàn zài zhèng chuān zhe ne
en: She has bought that coat and is wearing it right now.
why: The purchase has a result that holds now (she has the coat on): 了. 过 would mean the buying is a finished experience with no link to the present.

zh: 你有没有看过这场比赛？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo zhè chǎng bǐ sài
en: Have you ever seen this match?
why: 有没有 goes right before 看过, and the question takes no 吗. The object may be fronted as a topic.

q: 我外婆以前做___售货员，后来才开了自己的小店。
zh: 我外婆以前做过售货员，后来才开了自己的小店。
py: wǒ wài pó yǐ qián zuò guo shòu huò yuán hòu lái cái kāi le zì jǐ de xiǎo diàn
en: My grandmother used to work as a shop assistant before she opened her own little shop.
why: 以前 plus a later change in her life makes the job a past experience: 做过. 着 would mean she still does it, and 了 with a bare job title does not describe a past stage.

src_py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo
task: Say you have read it three times.
zh: 这本书我看过三遍。
py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo sān biàn
en: I have read this book three times.
why: The count follows 过: 看过三遍. 遍 fits reading a book through from start to finish.

q: 你吃过那家店的蛋糕___？
zh: 你吃过那家店的蛋糕没有？
py: nǐ chī guo nà jiā diàn de dàn gāo méi yǒu
en: Have you ever tried the cakes from that shop?
why: The tag question for experience is 没有: …过…没有？. Using 不 contradicts the 没 that negates 过, and 不是 and 不吃 do not ask about experience.

q: 我去那家餐厅吃___饭___，菜做得很地道。
zh: 我去那家餐厅吃过饭，菜做得很地道。
py: wǒ qù nà jiā cān tīng chī guo fàn cài zuò de hěn dì dao
en: I have eaten at that restaurant, and the food is authentic.
why: With 去 + place before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃 and before its object 饭. 吃饭过 leaves 过 after the object.

zh: 她在国家队打过排球。
py: tā zài guó jiā duì dǎ guo pái qiú
en: She has played volleyball on the national team.
why: The place phrase 在国家队 goes before the verb and 过 sits right after 打, before its object 排球.

q: 我在公园里打___太极拳___。
zh: 我在公园里打过太极拳。
py: wǒ zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ guo tài jí quán
en: I have done tai chi in the park.
why: 过 attaches to the verb 打, before the object 太极拳. After the object it would be left without a verb to belong to.

q: 他年轻的时候曾经参加___马拉松比赛，所以现在很会控制速度。
zh: 他年轻的时候曾经参加过马拉松比赛，所以现在很会控制速度。
py: tā nián qīng de shí hou céng jīng cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài suǒ yǐ xiàn zài hěn huì kòng zhì sù dù
en: When he was young he once took part in marathons, so he is good at pacing himself now.
why: The earlier experience explains his present skill, so 参加过. 曾经 rules out 了, and 着 would mean he is taking part right now.

s: 我去三次过那个公园。
s_py: wǒ qù sān cì guo nà ge gōng yuán
zh: 我去过三次那个公园。
py: wǒ qù guo sān cì nà ge gōng yuán
en: I have been to that park three times.
why: 过 sticks to the verb, and the count follows it. The count cannot come before 过.

q: 我从来没买___这么贵的球拍。
zh: 我从来没买过这么贵的球拍。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo zhè me guì de qiú pāi
en: I have never bought such an expensive racket.
why: 从来没…过 means 'never once'. 过 must stay, and 了 cannot follow 没.

q: 你说的那个球星，我没听___。
zh: 你说的那个球星，我没听过。
py: nǐ shuō de nà ge qiú xīng wǒ méi tīng guo
en: I have never heard of that football star you mentioned.
why: 没听过 says 'I have never heard of him'. 了 never follows 没, and 得 and 的 do not mark experience.

q: 球赛的重播我已经看___了，结果我都知道了。
zh: 球赛的重播我已经看过了，结果我都知道了。
py: qiú sài de chóng bō wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo le jié guǒ wǒ dōu zhī dào le
en: I've already watched the replay of the match, so I know the result.
why: 看过…了 = already done, with the topic fronted. 着 would mean I am watching it now, which contradicts knowing the result.
